title: 第013章 龙虎山道士人吓人剧情开始第014章 极品法器解锁建筑
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
苏辰停住脚步，回头看他。
男子拱手一礼，脸上带着笑，态度倒是坦荡。
“观兄台气息清正，又有道门根基，不知可是玄门中人？”
苏辰看了他一眼，也没隐瞒。
“在下茅山弟子，苏辰。”
男子眼神顿时一亮。
“原来是茅山高足。”
他说着，又拱手行礼。
“在下龙虎山张星野。”
他侧身让开半步，指向旁边的女子。
“这是舍妹，张清辞。”
张清辞听到哥哥介绍自己，勉强挤出一丝笑，“苏道兄好。”
她嘴上打招呼，眼神却忍不住往小黑狗身上飘。
小黑狗窝在苏辰臂弯里，爪子扒着他的袖子，安静得不像话。
张清辞看着看着，脸上又多了几分委屈。
张星野见状，往旁边移了半步，挡住她的视线。
张清辞抬头瞪了他一眼。
张星野当没看见，转而看向苏辰。
“苏兄，我们玄门弟子在外头遇上也算缘分。”
“不知能否一同喝杯茶，小叙几句？”

说到这里，他目光落在苏辰怀里的小黑狗上，连忙补了一句。
“苏兄别误会，我请你喝茶，和这只狗无关。”
“舍妹年纪小，性子也直，她喜欢小动物，方才多有冒昧，还请苏兄见谅。”
张清辞在后面小声嘀咕，“我也没有多冒昧......”
张星野回头看她。
她立刻闭嘴。
苏辰见这兄妹俩相处有趣，心里倒是少了几分戒备。
龙虎山弟子，气息纯净，又主动报了名号。
喝杯茶也无妨。
“可以。”苏辰点头。
三人很快在街边找了个茶摊。
茶摊搭在一棵老槐树下，三张方桌，几条长凳，炉子上烧着粗陶茶壶，水汽一阵阵往上冒。
摊主端来三碗热茶，又送了一小碟炒花生。
苏辰把小黑狗放在脚边。
小黑狗贴着他的鞋边趴下，眼睛盯着四周，耳朵时不时动两下。
张清辞一坐下，目光就落到它身上。
她从袖中摸出一块点心，掰了一小角，试探着往前递，“小黑，吃吗？”
小黑狗嗅了嗅，扭头看了苏辰一眼。
苏辰心里一动。
content_en:
Su Chen stopped and looked back at him.
The man bowed his hands in a salute, with a smile on his face and a magnanimous attitude.
"Guanxiongtai's aura is pure and pure, and he has a Taoist foundation. I wonder if he is a member of the Taoist sect?"
Su Chen glanced at him and didn't hide it.
"I'm a disciple of Maoshan, Su Chen."
The man's eyes suddenly lit up.
"It turns out to be a student from Maoshan."
He said and bowed again.
"I am Zhang Xingye at Longhu Mountain."
He stepped aside half a step and pointed at the woman next to him.
"This is my sister-in-law, Zhang Qingci."
When Zhang Qingci heard his brother introduce himself, he forced out a smile and said, "Hello, Brother Su Dao."
She said hello, but her eyes couldn't help but drift to the little black dog.
The little black dog nestled in Su Chen's arms, its paws picking up his sleeves, and it was unbelievably quiet.
Zhang Qingci looked at it with a bit of grievance on his face.
Seeing this, Zhang Xingye moved half a step to the side, blocking her view.
Zhang Qingci raised his head and glared at him.
Zhang Xingye pretended not to see it and turned to look at Su Chen.
"Brother Su, it is fate that we Xuanmen disciples meet outside."
"I wonder if we can have a cup of tea together and chat for a while?"
Having said this, his eyes fell on the little black dog in Su Chen's arms, and he quickly added.
"Brother Su, don't get me wrong. My invitation to you to drink tea has nothing to do with this dog."
"My roommate is young and has a straightforward temper. She likes small animals. She was so presumptuous just now. Please forgive me, Brother Su."
Zhang Qingci whispered from behind, "I'm not too presumptuous..."
Zhang Xingye looked back at her.
She shut up immediately.
Seeing that the brother and sister had fun getting along with each other, Su Chen felt a little less wary.
The disciple of Longhu Mountain, with pure aura, took the initiative to report his name.
It doesn’t hurt to have a cup of tea.
"Okay." Su Chen nodded.
The three of them quickly found a tea stall on the street.
The tea stall was set up under an old locust tree, with three square tables and a few benches. A stoneware teapot was burning on the stove, and steam was rising up.
The stall owner brought three bowls of hot tea and a small plate of fried peanuts.
Su Chen put the little black dog at his feet.
The little black dog lay down next to his shoes, staring at the surroundings and moving its ears from time to time.
As soon as Zhang Qingci sat down, his eyes fell on it.
She took out a piece of snack from her sleeve, broke off a small corner, and tentatively handed it forward, "Xiao Hei, do you want to eat?"
The little black dog sniffed and turned to look at Su Chen.
Su Chen's heart moved.
